inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, makefile, source/site folders, media counts, and link feeds

anchors.why: Describes Oscean as a Uxn/Uxntal static wiki with plain-text tables and build commands.
Shows reproducible generation of ROMs, link XML, docs index, and site output.
Shows timestamped link/event records that can inspire episode-style provenance.
Contains custom source for the static wiki generator.
Contains rendered site projection separate from source.

known_limits: The custom Uxn toolchain is not a practical VAKS dependency.
Generated link maps are navigation aids, not reviewed relations.
Personal-site content and media should not be imported.
